# v3.22-dev

## Fixed

Five more pages now remember the view you set up. Previously each of these
reset to its defaults the moment you reloaded, shared the link, or opened
something and came back:

- **Dashboard** — the geography scope and the "include expired" tickbox.
- **Theatre/Region/Country Comparison** — the largest of them: geography mode,
  date range (including a custom one), the function, product and type filters,
  the comparison mode and the column sort.
- **Training Catalogue Health** — the product, type and status filters, plus
  the column sort.
- **Program Compliance Trend** — the selected program and the
  theatre/region/country scope, plus the column sort.
- **Renewal Forecast** — the product filter and the theatre/region/country
  scope, plus the column sort.

That completes the set: **every report and dashboard in the app now restores
its view**, and any new one has to, because the build checks it.

## Also in this release

- Each of these pages is now **bookmarkable and shareable**. Set a report up the
  way you want it, copy the address, and whoever opens it sees the same view —
  same filters, same scope, same sort.
- A link that names something no longer there — a product filter for a deleted
  product, a sort on a column that has gone — falls back to the default view
  rather than showing you an empty or unsorted table.

## Notes for self-hosted installs

No database changes and no configuration changes. Existing bookmarks to these
pages keep working exactly as before; they simply open at the default view, as
they always did.
